field.description: The field to show: the full field type name (for example 'module/fieldTypes/name'), 'title' or 'workflowState'.

showLabel.description: Whether to show the field's label next to its value. Defaults to true for the 'row' display and false for 'inline'.

display.description: How the field is shown: 'row' as a labelled row of its own, 'inline' within the surrounding text. Defaults to 'row'.
